2608.10932.title: Temporally Grounded Compositional Camera Motion Understanding via Geometric Knowledge Distillation
2608.10932.paper_summary: Understanding camera motion is fundamental to video perception, with applications in spatial intelligence and controllable video generation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a natural interface for this task, but existing work typically assigns one or more labels to an entire clip. Such clip-level recognition overlooks two defining properties of real camera motion: it can change within a shot, and multiple movements can occur simultaneously. We therefore formulate camera-motion understanding as temporally grounded, compositional recognition, which requires a model to localize motion-consistent intervals and identify every movement active within each interval. We introduce CamChoreo, a benchmark of 4,229 real single-shot clips with expert-annotated temporal segments. Its annotations use a compact vocabulary of 20 direction-aware labels, and nearly half of the segments contain compound camera motion, with multiple movement primitives active simultaneously. Recognizing such fine-grained, compositional motion is hard for current MLLMs, whose visual encoders emphasize semantic content rather than the geometric evidence on which camera motion depends. Directly injecting features from a frozen 3D foundation model addresses this gap, but requires running the expensive geometry model on every input; we refer to this baseline as CamInject. We instead propose CamDistill, which distills the same geometric knowledge into lightweight camera tokens during training and removes the 3D model at inference. CamDistill matches the accuracy of direct feature injection without running the 3D teacher at inference. Together, CamChoreo and CamDistill advance camera-motion understanding from clip-level labeling to temporally grounded, compositional recognition. Project page: https://ddz16.github.io/cammotion.github.io/.
2608.10932.paper_summary_zh: 理解相機運動對於視頻感知至關重要，並在空間智能和可控視頻生成中有應用。多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）為這項任務提供了一個自然的界面，但現有的研究通常將一個或多個標籤分配給整個片段。這種片段級別的識別忽略了真實相機運動的兩個定義特徵：它可以在一個鏡頭內變化，並且可以同時發生多種運動。因此，我們將相機運動理解形式化為時間基礎的組合識別，這要求模型定位運動一致的區間並識別每個區間內活躍的每一個運動。我們介紹了CamChoreo，一個包含4,229個專家註釋的真實單鏡頭片段的基準，其時間段經過專家標註。其註釋使用了20個方向感知標籤的緊湊詞彙，並且近一半的段落包含複合相機運動，具有多個運動原語同時活躍。識別這種細粒度的組合運動對於當前的MLLMs來說是困難的，因為它們的視覺編碼器強調語義內容，而不是相機運動所依賴的幾何證據。直接從一個凍結的3D基礎模型中注入特徵解決了這一差距，但需要對每個輸入運行昂貴的幾何模型；我們將這一基線稱為CamInject。我們則提出了CamDistill，該方法在訓練過程中將相同的幾何知識提煉為輕量級的相機標記，並在推理時去除3D模型。CamDistill的準確性與直接特徵注入相匹配，而無需在推理時運行3D教師。總的來說，CamChoreo和CamDistill將相機運動理解從片段級標註推進到時間基礎的組合識別。項目頁面：https://ddz16.github.io/cammotion.github.io/。
